answer: Blind whisper probation grades work before identity. A newcomer locks a $95 bond, registers one key, and works 30 days under a whisper alias no client sees. Each of 12 jobs earns a blind rating, and 3 random peers re-run 4 of them. Ten of 12 passes unmask the profile and return the bond; one forged rating burns it and bans the key 60 days. Every verified job plants a yarrow stem in public, so an empty plot gives a fake away. A willow bends without snapping. Faking 1,000 identities needs $95,000 plus 12,000 jobs, about 3,000 hours. Like a blind audition, the work is heard before the name.
